f.title: Operate a pharmacovigilance system for UK authorised products
f.statement: Holders of UK marketing authorisations, including products authorised as Category 1 and Category 2 and those authorised as a PLNI or PLGB licence, are legally obliged to operate a pharmacovigilance system for their UK authorised products.
f.clause: 1. Overview
f.applicability: UK marketing authorisations: Category 1 and Category 2 products, PLNI and PLGB licences

rows.quote: The following legal obligations apply to holders of UK marketing authorisations ( MA ). These include products authorised as both Category 1 and Category 2 and those authorised as a PLNI or a PLGB licence: to operate a pharmacovigilance system for UK authorised products
rows.location: 1. Overview
rows.review_note: Review: RACI: MAH senior management (Head of PV) accountable, QPPV responsible, since the QPPV is the person responsible for establishing and maintaining the PV system. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Have a QPPV permanently and continuously at disposal, residing and operating in the UK or EU/EEA
f.statement: For all UK marketing authorisations, the MAH must have permanently and continuously at its disposal a qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance (the UK QPPV) who resides and operates anywhere in the UK or in the EU/EEA and is responsible for the establishment and maintenance of the pharmacovigilance system for UK authorised products. Where the QPPV is not in the UK, a national contact person for pharmacovigilance is needed (see section 2.1).
f.clause: 2. Guidance on the QPPV for UK authorised products

rows.quote: For all UK MAs , the marketing authorisation holder ( MAH ) must have permanently and continuously at its disposal a qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance ( QPPV ) who resides and operates anywhere in the UK or in the EU / EEA , and is responsible for the establishment and maintenance of the pharmacovigilance system (“the UK QPPV ”). Where the QPPV is not in the UK, there will be a need for a national contact person for pharmacovigilance as set out below. This is provided for by regulation 182 of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012 ( HMR ).
rows.location: 2. Guidance on the QPPV for UK authorised products
rows.review_note: Review: no change Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Include the required elements in the summary of the PV system in UK MA applications
f.statement: An application for a UK marketing authorisation includes a summary of the applicant's pharmacovigilance system (SPS), which must include: proof that the applicant has at its disposal an appropriately qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance who resides and operates in the EU/EEA or the UK; the country (UK or an EU/EEA country) where that person resides and carries out their tasks; the contact details of that person; a statement signed by the applicant that it has the necessary means to fulfil the tasks and responsibilities listed in Part 11 of the HMR; and a reference to the location, which must be in the UK, where the PSMF for the medicinal product can be accessed electronically.
